development_selection.final_fit: after selecting the threshold, means/scales/coefficients/intercept are refit on all 183 A+B development candidates
development_selection.grouping: whole source recordings; deterministic folds stratified by session and target
development_selection.operating_threshold: one grouped-OOF score vector over pooled A+B; require >=95% positive-candidate recall, minimize negative false accepts, maximize positive accepts, then choose highest threshold
development_selection.preprocessing: each grouped OOF fold learns transforms' standardization and model only from its training rows

features.dc_reference: subtract each channel's mean over up to 12 ms immediately before detector onset; use the complete candidate only when that reference is empty
features.dc_treatment: set the pooled zero-frequency power bin to zero
features.fft: np.fft.rfft independently by channel with n=2400 and no normalization; bins from np.fft.rfftfreq(2400, 1/48000)
features.name: spectral_bandwidth_hz
features.window: NumPy symmetric Hann: np.hanning(2400), equivalent to 0.5 - 0.5*cos(2*pi*n/(M-1))

features.definition: for each channel compare np.signbit(sample[i+1]) != np.signbit(sample[i]); average all adjacent comparisons across time and the two channels
features.denominator: (interval_frame_count - 1) * 2 channels; return zero when fewer than two interval frames are available
features.name: post_0_100_zero_crossing_rate
features.zero_rule: positive zero is nonnegative under np.signbit; IEEE negative zero retains its negative sign bit

feature_schema.finite_value_handling: candidate samples and extracted features must be finite; invalid values are rejected

late_context_ablation.reason: 100-180 ms context improved development negative rejection but reduced tap recall and adds roughly 100 ms history/latency

standardization.rule: all-A+B transformed-feature population mean/std (ddof=0); replace scale <=1e-12 with 1

model.uncalibrated_score: sigmoid of standardized linear decision score

candidate_routes.strong_impact_recovery: RMS ratio AND peak ratio; no crest requirement
